zh.title: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空擴大哩程合作
zh.summary: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空推出雙向哩程兌換及累積服務
body: 星宇航空宣佈與阿提哈德航空深化合作，合作範圍延伸至會員哩程計畫，推出雙向哩程兌換及累積服務。星宇航空表示，雙方會員可用累積哩程兌換對方航空公司營運航班的酬賓機票。
星宇航空表示，搭乘符合資格的航班也可累積哩程，並提供補登服務。星宇航空執行長翟健華表示，結合雙方航網與哩程計畫後，會員可經由阿提哈德航空位於阿布達比的樞紐延伸旅程，前往全球超過120個目的地。

en.title: Starlux Airlines and Etihad Airways Expand Mileage Partnership
en.summary: Starlux and Etihad expand mileage cooperation with two-way redemption and accrual services
body: Starlux Airlines announced that it is deepening its partnership with Etihad Airways and extending the cooperation to their member mileage programs. The airlines are introducing two-way mileage redemption and accrual services. Starlux said members of either program can use accumulated miles to redeem award tickets on flights operated by the other airline.

Members can also earn miles on qualifying flights, and the airlines offer a service for claiming mileage credits retroactively. Starlux’s chief executive said combining the airlines’ networks and mileage programs gives members options to extend trips through Etihad Airways’ hub in Abu Dhabi to more than 120 destinations worldwide.
